question: Ram started from Point A and walked 5 km towards the east, and then, after turning to his right, walked 4 km. He then turned to his right and walked 5 km. Again, he turned to his right and walked 5 km to stop at Point P. In which direction should he walk to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Ram started from Point A and walked 5 km towards the east

He then takes a turn to his right, walked 4 km.

 He then turned to his right and walked 5 km.

He turned to his right and walked 5 km to stop at Point P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f794c5db879bf347502d9150a51b5ea45121814c2523a531197a6b2b50fa9af9.png] 

So, He should walk towards **South **to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
